objective: Audit Christoffel defect area as an exact adjacent-swap and factor-complexity control for critical first-crossing words and coprime cycle profiles, while preserving the nonperiodic/positive-cycle hypotheses and finite/asymptotic boundary.

quantifiers: all coefficient-safe first-crossing words for P141 and the conditional least-counterexample branch for P142
all primitive positive integer shortcut cycles with coprime odd-count/length for P144 and P145
all large cycles only under the effective polynomial minimum hypothesis for P146
all critical first-crossing words through q<=17 for the exhaustive part of E35
all valid coprime Phase 22 profiles of area at most 2 through q<=22 and all positive exponent compositions through q<=8 for the bounded cycle part of E35
exact_scope.completeness: The q<=17 critical enumeration is complete in its declared range. Direct substring reconstruction is complete through q<=12 and theorem-level outside that finite check. The cycle q<=22 scope is complete only for defect area at most two; no bounded count is promoted to an eventual H89 or H133 theorem.

arithmetic.exact_methods: arbitrary-precision integers, exact rational height comparisons, literal substring sets, adjacent swaps, and integer logarithm ceilings
arithmetic.floating_point_role: none in generator or verifier acceptance decisions

verifier_reconstructs: critical safe words by a separately written prefix recursion and every area/contact aggregate
area as both prefix-count excess and a literal adjacent-swap count
finite factor sets by direct slicing rather than generator encodings
coprime cycle profiles from literal exponent compositions and direct cyclic substrings
positive and negative cycle scope regressions

stop_conditions: Do not apply state distinctness or P125 separation to a periodic branch, a rational noninteger shadow, or a negative cycle.
Do not infer q0 or eventual area growth from q<=17 critical enumeration or area<=2 cycle profiles.
Do not use the cycle profile area before reconstructing the residue-to-time indexing and literal expanded word.
Do not drop the one-factor terminal boundary defect of the finite critical mechanical word; NG32 is the minimal falsifier.
Do not use Wu-Wang, Christoffel extremality, or an effective linear form unless its exact hypothesis is separately audited.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before changing proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: The critical repetition inequality is conditional on P54 and pairwise distinct states; it does not cover a periodic least-counterexample branch.
The cycle factor-separation inequality is only a necessary condition for a primitive positive integer cycle and does not apply to negative or merely rational affine cycles.
H89, H133, H112, H72, every remaining P69 branch, and Collatz remain open; proves_collatz remains false.
